panels.title: Is anything attacking us right now?

panels.description: Events in the selected time range

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '$__interval') AS time, count(*) AS events FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (NULLIF('${src_ip}', '') IS NULL OR host(src_ip) = NULLIF('${src_ip}', '')) AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR '${agent_id}' = 'All' OR agent_id = '${agent_id}') AND (NULLIF('${channel}', '') IS NULL OR '${channel}' = 'All' OR channel = '${channel}') AND (NULLIF('${severity}', '') IS NULL OR wazuh_rule_level >= NULLIF('${severity}', '')::int) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Events

panels.description: Highest Wazuh rule level in range

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '$__interval') AS time, coalesce(max(wazuh_rule_level), 0) AS peak_level FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (NULLIF('${src_ip}', '') IS NULL OR host(src_ip) = NULLIF('${src_ip}', '')) AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR '${agent_id}' = 'All' OR agent_id = '${agent_id}') AND (NULLIF('${channel}', '') IS NULL OR '${channel}' = 'All' OR channel = '${channel}') AND (NULLIF('${severity}', '') IS NULL OR wazuh_rule_level >= NULLIF('${severity}', '')::int) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Peak alert level

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, $__interval), channel AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (NULLIF('${src_ip}', '') IS NULL OR host(src_ip) = NULLIF('${src_ip}', '')) AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR '${agent_id}' = 'All' OR agent_id = '${agent_id}') AND (NULLIF('${channel}', '') IS NULL OR '${channel}' = 'All' OR channel = '${channel}') AND (NULLIF('${severity}', '') IS NULL OR wazuh_rule_level >= NULLIF('${severity}', '')::int) GROUP BY 1, channel ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Peak Wazuh level per bucket — spikes visible (not diluted by low-level noise)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, $__interval), max(wazuh_rule_level) AS value FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND wazuh_rule_level IS NOT NULL AND (NULLIF('${src_ip}', '') IS NULL OR host(src_ip) = NULLIF('${src_ip}', '')) AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR '${agent_id}' = 'All' OR agent_id = '${agent_id}') AND (NULLIF('${channel}', '') IS NULL OR '${channel}' = 'All' OR channel = '${channel}') AND (NULLIF('${severity}', '') IS NULL OR wazuh_rule_level >= NULLIF('${severity}', '')::int) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Peak alert level over time

targets.rawSql: SELECT host(src_ip) AS src_ip, count(*) AS events, max(wazuh_rule_level) AS max_level FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND src_ip IS NOT NULL AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR '${agent_id}' = 'All' OR agent_id = '${agent_id}') AND (NULLIF('${channel}', '') IS NULL OR '${channel}' = 'All' OR channel = '${channel}') AND (NULLIF('${severity}', '') IS NULL OR wazuh_rule_level >= NULLIF('${severity}', '')::int) GROUP BY src_ip ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT CASE WHEN wazuh_rule_level >= 12 THEN '12+ critical' WHEN wazuh_rule_level >= 10 THEN '10-11 high' WHEN wazuh_rule_level >= 7 THEN '7-9 medium' WHEN wazuh_rule_level >= 3 THEN '3-6 low' ELSE '0-2 info' END AS level_band, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND wazuh_rule_level IS NOT NULL AND (NULLIF('${src_ip}', '') IS NULL OR host(src_ip) = NULLIF('${src_ip}', '')) AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR '${agent_id}' = 'All' OR agent_id = '${agent_id}') AND (NULLIF('${channel}', '') IS NULL OR '${channel}' = 'All' OR channel = '${channel}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT host(e.src_ip) AS src_ip, max(g.country_code) AS country_code, max(g.country_name) AS country_name, max(g.lat) AS latitude, max(g.lon) AS longitude, max(COALESCE((SELECT d.decision FROM decisions d WHERE d.event_id = e.id LIMIT 1), CASE WHEN e.event_type IN ('auth_failed', 'cowrie_session', 'rootkit_detected', 'fim_change') THEN 'alert' WHEN e.event_type = 'auth_success' THEN 'allow' ELSE 'unclassified' END)) AS decision, count(*) AS events FROM events e INNER JOIN ip_geolocation g ON g.ip = e.src_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND e.src_ip IS NOT NULL AND g.lat IS NOT NULL AND g.lon IS NOT NULL AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR '${agent_id}' = 'All' OR e.agent_id = '${agent_id}') AND (NULLIF('${channel}', '') IS NULL OR '${channel}' = 'All' OR e.channel = '${channel}') AND (NULLIF('${severity}', '') IS NULL OR e.wazuh_rule_level >= NULLIF('${severity}', '')::int) GROUP BY e.src_ip ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Geolocated attack sources (public IPs only)
panels.description: LAN/private IPs (127.x, 192.168.x) are listed in the panel to the right — they cannot be placed on a world map.
Private or unknown IPs not shown on map

targets.rawSql: SELECT host(e.src_ip) AS src_ip, count(*) AS events, max(e.wazuh_rule_level) AS max_level FROM events e LEFT JOIN ip_geolocation g ON g.ip = e.src_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND e.src_ip IS NOT NULL AND g.ip IS NULL AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR '${agent_id}' = 'All' OR e.agent_id = '${agent_id}') AND (NULLIF('${channel}', '') IS NULL OR '${channel}' = 'All' OR e.channel = '${channel}') AND (NULLIF('${severity}', '') IS NULL OR e.wazuh_rule_level >= NULLIF('${severity}', '')::int) GROUP BY e.src_ip ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: IPs without geolocation

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(agent_name, 'unknown') AS host, agent_id, count(*) AS events, max(wazuh_rule_level) AS max_level FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id IS NOT NULL AND (NULLIF('${src_ip}', '') IS NULL OR host(src_ip) = NULLIF('${src_ip}', '')) AND (NULLIF('${channel}', '') IS NULL OR '${channel}' = 'All' OR channel = '${channel}') AND (NULLIF('${severity}', '') IS NULL OR wazuh_rule_level >= NULLIF('${severity}', '')::int) GROUP BY agent_name, agent_id ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT channel, event_type, count(*) AS cnt FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (NULLIF('${src_ip}', '') IS NULL OR host(src_ip) = NULLIF('${src_ip}', '')) AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR '${agent_id}' = 'All' OR agent_id = '${agent_id}') AND (NULLIF('${channel}', '') IS NULL OR '${channel}' = 'All' OR channel = '${channel}') AND (NULLIF('${severity}', '') IS NULL OR wazuh_rule_level >= NULLIF('${severity}', '')::int) GROUP BY channel, event_type ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 15

panels.description: Distinct agents with events in range — inverted: too few reporting means the fleet went quiet

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '$__interval') AS time, count(DISTINCT agent_id) AS agents FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id IS NOT NULL AND (NULLIF('${src_ip}', '') IS NULL OR host(src_ip) = NULLIF('${src_ip}', '')) AND (NULLIF('${channel}', '') IS NULL OR '${channel}' = 'All' OR channel = '${channel}') AND (NULLIF('${severity}', '') IS NULL OR wazuh_rule_level >= NULLIF('${severity}', '')::int) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Agents reporting

panels.description: Ingest quality — events without agent_id

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '$__interval') AS time, count(*) AS missing_agent FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id IS NULL AND (NULLIF('${src_ip}', '') IS NULL OR host(src_ip) = NULLIF('${src_ip}', '')) AND (NULLIF('${channel}', '') IS NULL OR '${channel}' = 'All' OR channel = '${channel}') AND (NULLIF('${severity}', '') IS NULL OR wazuh_rule_level >= NULLIF('${severity}', '')::int) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Missing agent_id

panels.description: Point-in-time: seconds since the most recent event. Freshness, not a trend.

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM (now() - max(ts))) AS seconds_since_last_event FROM events WHERE (NULLIF('${src_ip}', '') IS NULL OR host(src_ip) = NULLIF('${src_ip}', '')) AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR '${agent_id}' = 'All' OR agent_id = '${agent_id}') AND (NULLIF('${channel}', '') IS NULL OR '${channel}' = 'All' OR channel = '${channel}')

panels.title: Last event ingested

panels.description: Point-in-time snapshot of the posture cache. `cve_findings` is overwritten by each scan, so no history exists to trend.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS critical_cves FROM cve_findings WHERE severity = 'critical' AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR '${agent_id}' = 'All' OR agent_id = '${agent_id}')

panels.title: Critical CVEs

panels.description: Point-in-time snapshot of the posture cache, replaced by each SCA scan.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN s.result IN ('passed', 'pass') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(sum(CASE WHEN s.result IN ('passed', 'pass', 'failed', 'fail') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS fleet_sca_pct FROM sca_findings s WHERE s.check_id != 'none' AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR '${agent_id}' = 'All' OR s.agent_id = '${agent_id}')

panels.title: Fleet SCA pass %

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS failed_checks FROM sca_findings WHERE result IN ('failed', 'fail') AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR '${agent_id}' = 'All' OR agent_id = '${agent_id}')

panels.title: SCA failed checks
panels.description: Point-in-time snapshot of the posture cache, replaced by each SCA scan.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS high_epss FROM cve_findings WHERE epss_score > 0.5 AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR '${agent_id}' = 'All' OR agent_id = '${agent_id}')

panels.title: High EPSS CVEs
panels.description: Point-in-time snapshot of the posture cache, replaced by each CVE scan.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS risky_users FROM user_findings WHERE risk_level IN ('critical', 'high', 'medium') AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR '${agent_id}' = 'All' OR agent_id = '${agent_id}')

panels.title: Risky local users
panels.description: Point-in-time snapshot of the posture cache, replaced by each user scan.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS eol_hosts FROM hosts WHERE eol_os = true AND agent_id != '000' AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR '${agent_id}' = 'All' OR agent_id = '${agent_id}')

panels.title: EOL OS hosts
panels.description: Point-in-time snapshot of current fleet state.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::int AS image_cves FROM container_cve_findings WHERE (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR '${agent_id}' = 'All' OR agent_id = '${agent_id}')

panels.title: Container image CVEs
panels.description: Point-in-time snapshot of the posture cache, replaced by each Trivy scan.

targets.rawSql: SELECT h.name, h.agent_id, host(h.ip) AS ip, h.criticality, h.eol_os, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN s.result IN ('passed', 'pass') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(sum(CASE WHEN s.result IN ('passed', 'pass', 'failed', 'fail') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS sca_pct, coalesce((SELECT jsonb_array_length(cr.containers) FROM container_runtime cr WHERE cr.agent_id = h.agent_id), 0) AS containers, (SELECT count(*) FROM container_cve_findings cc WHERE cc.agent_id = h.agent_id) AS image_cves, (SELECT count(*) FROM user_findings u WHERE u.agent_id = h.agent_id AND u.risk_level IN ('critical', 'high', 'medium') AND u.username != '_none_') AS risky_users, (SELECT count(*) FROM cve_findings c WHERE c.agent_id = h.agent_id AND c.epss_score > 0.5 AND c.actionable = true) AS high_epss_cves, greatest((SELECT max(scanned_at) FROM cve_findings c WHERE c.agent_id = h.agent_id), (SELECT max(scanned_at) FROM sca_findings s2 WHERE s2.agent_id = h.agent_id), (SELECT max(scanned_at) FROM user_findings u2 WHERE u2.agent_id = h.agent_id), (SELECT max(scanned_at) FROM container_cve_findings cc2 WHERE cc2.agent_id = h.agent_id)) AS last_posture_scan FROM hosts h LEFT JOIN sca_findings s ON s.agent_id = h.agent_id AND s.check_id != 'none' WHERE h.agent_id != '000' AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR '${agent_id}' = 'All' OR h.agent_id = '${agent_id}') GROUP BY h.name, h.agent_id, h.ip, h.criticality, h.eol_os ORDER BY CASE h.criticality WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, h.name

panels.description: Point-in-time: how many investigations are open right now. Not a trend — `investigations` records state, not a per-hour history.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS open_inv FROM investigations WHERE status = 'open'

panels.title: Open investigations

targets.rawSql: SELECT i.started_at, i.subject, i.status, i.severity, i.verdict FROM investigations i WHERE i.status = 'open' ORDER BY i.started_at DESC LIMIT 8

panels.description: Longer time-to-detect is worse

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(i.started_at, '$__interval') AS time, round(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (i.started_at - e.ts)))) AS avg_mttd_sec FROM investigations i JOIN events e ON e.ts <= i.started_at WHERE $__timeFilter(i.started_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Avg MTTD (sec)

panels.description: Longer time-to-resolve is worse

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(closed_at, '$__interval') AS time, round(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (closed_at - started_at)))) AS avg_mttr_sec FROM investigations WHERE status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(closed_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Avg MTTR (sec)

panels.description: Fraction 0-1: a higher false-positive rate is worse

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(closed_at, '$__interval') AS time, round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict = 'false_positive')::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 3) AS fpr FROM investigations WHERE status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(closed_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: False positive rate

panels.description: Point-in-time: blocks awaiting human confirmation right now.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS pending_blocks FROM blocklist WHERE executed = false
